notes.title: Patch 1.02 + Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
[b]Minor Changes[/b]

Bugfixes
- Fixed game-breaking issues with the Ring of Hermes
- Fixed items that disappeared when you quickly switched to them from a one-use item (dynamite, herb, cornucopia)
- Made Crystal Guardian (ghost) boss awake quicker when close to player
- Game runs in background when alt-tabbed

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
[b]Major Changes[/b]

A new [b]unlockable[/b] character has been added!

- The Oracle
[i]Character is locked at the start[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Z7rwNWf.png[/img]

The Oracle starts with a Skeleton Staff, a Ring of Hermes, and a Bone Charm. He also starts with higher max stamina and low speed. This means that the Oracle has to use teleportation to dodge enemy attacks while dealing mid-ranged damage with his Staff to enemies. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uhhBpNh.gif[/img]

[b]Minor Changes[/b]

- Staff of Hermes has been changed to a ring that can be equipped instead of being an active item. This will make teleportation smoother and more useful in combat.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/yDjpb8f.png[/img]



- InfernoSoul [img]http://i.imgur.com/5TIY3Co.gif[/img]

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
After 2 years of development, Underworld Dungeon is [i]finally[/i] released! 
The game costs $7.99 and is now available on Windows, OSX, and Linux.
Free weekly updates will hit the game these coming few months that will add more content such as new items, enemies and bosses.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XNEqYYz.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HlSqHqo.gif[/img]

Once again, thanks to everyone who has supported Underworld Dungeon since its Kickstarter and Greenlight!

Developer: [url=https://twitter.com/InfernoSoulDev]InfernoSoul[/url]
Publisher: [url=https://twitter.com/PandaFromjaf]Panda Games[/url]
Audio: [url=https://soundcloud.com/pixel-noise]Pixel Noise[/url]

notes.title: Progress Update 4: Nearing Completion
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to what is most likely the penultimate progress update. Underworld Dungeon is nearing its completion, and we cannot wait to share all that we have with you. Firstly, we would like to get straight to the point.

Barring any complications, [b] Underworld Dungeon will be releasing on July 31st 2017 for Windows, OSX and Linux. [/b]

The game will retail for $9.99 with an initial discount of 15%, and will ship with at least five unique characters, over 100 items, a fully fledged crafting system and many secrets, enemies and NPC's to be discovered within the dungeon.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26300138/7892420378fcc1b961a6bf7b4092ed65a70db76d.png[/img]
[b]Just some of the many items available in the game [/b]

[h1] Music and Digital Deluxe [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26300138/d4eef586430243d1489f43a009e0729ea11e8bb3.jpg[/img]

If you are not already aware, the OST for the game has been worked on by the talented  duo of professional composers, [url=https://soundcloud.com/pixel-noise] Pixel Noise[/url], and they have constantly amazed us with their exceptional score for the game. While the music for the game can be listened to in it's entirety on their [url=https://soundcloud.com/pixel-noise/sets/underworld-dungeon-ost] SoundCloud[/url], you will also be able to purchase it alongside the game to help support them, either separately in $7.50 DLC, or in the Deluxe Edition for the game, including the OST, the game and a digital art book and strategy guide, costing only $5 more then the game itself.

[h1] Crafting [/h1]

One of the major aspects of the game is in the crafting system. It is one of the few ways that you can obtain items, along with finding them in chests and being able to purchase them through souls. When you first start the game, you will likely not be able to craft anything useful. This is because you learn how to craft the many items to be found in the game through crafting recipes. There are three main ways of obtaining crafting recipes, through both unlocking achievements, and defeating bosses. The chance of getting a recipe can vary based on what you do through the game, with one guaranteed through each achievement, and a 25% chance of unlocking one through each boss killed.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26300138/4d40bcad3396326b8b24a35812cf0f7c57e11413.gif[/img]

As always, we would like to thank you for supporting us since we had started the Kickstarter and Greenlight, and hope that you enjoy the game on it's release.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/QOmx60E.gif[/img]

Panda Games and InfernoSoul

notes.title: Progress Update 2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I've worked on many features in the past few months. Here's what I've added to and changed in the game:


[b]- A new flying enemy has been added that fires 3 crystal projectiles at the player[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZH9B4hU.gif[/img]


[b]- Another new enemy has been added which can dodge player attacks[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/N4JPTt1.gif[/img]


[b]- Spears are now thrown[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fRkldRM.gif[/img]


[b]- Poseidon's Trident now activates only upon taking damage[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ePZeOfJ.gif[/img]


[b]- Spikes are added as traps to the Crystal Depths biome[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/EuSW7l2.gif[/img]


[b]- This bug-like enemy now fires a laser orb at the player[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sutk2K5.gif[/img]


[b]- New bat enemy added to the Mossy Caves biome[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0sXIpB2.gif[/img]


[b]- Another enemy added which lunges at the player and then throws a dagger[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/K2pYhGl.gif[/img]

Make sure to tune in next time for more, same bat time, same bat place.
